scientific.integrity: The two random-reshuffling epoch maps are composed directly from the two component-gradient steps. The resulting affine contraction is solved exactly, and standard Bernoulli-convolution support facts are applied only after that optimizer-specific identification.
limitations: Two equally weighted scalar quadratics with equal curvature and opposite minimizers.
Independent fresh reshuffling at every epoch and a constant normalized step in the stable range.
The full-support classification is for epoch-start iterates, not inner-epoch iterates.
For contraction parameter above one half, interval support is proved but no general density or absolute-continuity claim is made.
The known exact quadratic mean-square formula is treated as prior work rather than as a new contribution.

title: Random reshuffling has a Cantor-to-interval stationary-support transition
